verdicts.reason: A follows a sensible top-to-bottom story order and keeps everything readable, but the stack is mixed: GROVE is centred while the headline and body are left-aligned, and the pills and CTA are right-aligned with the CTA hard against the right margin. The bottom ~50px is cramped while the space above the circle is loose. B is broken: the headline sits on top of the product circle and nearly touches the shoe, GROVE is placed inside the circle, all the content is packed into the top 2/3 leaving a large empty lower third, and FREE DELIVERY is stranded in the bottom-left corner at an illegible size, with the pills and CTA shrunk too small.
